notes: Six items queued from the 2026-09-17 poll, all read. Three name no address.

coverage.note: The Haight Street Fair piece's apparent addresses — 7 Haight, 33 Ashbury, 43 Masonic, 37 Corbett — are Muni line numbers followed by street names, not addresses. Worth a screen note, not a finding.

findings.description: An EEOC settlement requires the business trading at 560 Broadway to pay a former employee $40,000 in a pregnancy discrimination case.

citation.label: Hoodline, “EEOC Settlement Requires Condor Club to Pay Former Employee $40,000,” 17 September 2026

publish.note: Declined on the ten-year test and on privacy. An employment discrimination settlement is a fact about how a business treated a person, not about the building it trades from; nothing happened to 560 Broadway. The story is also about a former employee, and root AGENTS.md keeps people off these pages.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 560 BROADWAY (neither the record nor EAS gives this street a type) → parcel 0145013; sf-parcels has blklot 0145013 active, 560–560 BROADWAY; the 2025 roll records it as commercial hotel, built 1907. The assessor files the parcel as 300–318 COLUMBUS AV.

findings.description: Hoodline's write-up of the same renderings for the 70-74 Laidley Street infill, citing San Francisco YIMBY's reporting.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Fairmount Heights Hillside Home Giving Way to $8M, 40-Foot Apartment Complex,” 17 September 2026

publish.note: One event, one entry. The same renderings are carried by 2026-09-17-yb-0003 from San Francisco YIMBY, which published first and which this article cites as its source. The passing mentions of 129, 151 and 60 Laidley Street are a paragraph of block history quoted from earlier YIMBY coverage, not events.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 70 LAIDLEY ST → parcel 7538015; sf-parcels has blklot 7538015 active, 70–70 LAIDLEY; the 2025 roll records it as single family residential, built 1900.

findings.description: The 47th Haight Street Fair closes five blocks of Haight Street on Sunday, with Muni reroutes.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Haight Street Fair Turns 47, Shuts Down Five Blocks This Sunday,” 16 September 2026

publish.note: Declined. A street fair is an event on a street, not at a building, and the article names no building it happens to. The numbers the reader flagged — 7 Haight, 33 Ashbury, 43 Masonic, 37 Corbett — are Muni lines.

resolution.method: The record states no street number, so there is nothing to look up in sf-eas-addresses.
resolution.note: The record locates it only as "Haight Street (five blocks)" — the street (HAIGHT ST). Kept so the record is not read again; per the evidence bar in research/AGENTS.md it cannot become a page.
